referencePolicy: Explicit target-key-only iterator reuses the same prepared metadata, binding, fence, native ordering and fused page guards; it performs no timestamp-intent loading or HMAC comparison and never tries the source key.
completeVerifierDurationPolicy: finalMs is max(source iterator lifetime, complete verifier receipt duration); includes complete header/fence/chunk validation, row comparisons and owned cleanup. Source lifetime is diagnostic only.
streamingComparisonPolicy: The exact bounded page snapshot is guarded inside every scanner query; no separate final-size phase exists. All fused guard, row authentication, timestamp validation and canonical HMAC comparison time remains in finalMs, streamingFinalMs, totalMs and overheadMs.
comparisonPolicy: Checkpointing remains in the matched safe rotation baseline; supplementary protection overhead includes backup creation, offline verification, all safety hooks and control work.
cacheProtocol: Warm initial source; exact frozen 48db5f3af0 synchronous runtime and128/semi4 policy for protected/reference. Persistent PGDATA/artifacts. All guards and complete verifier included. Host-load and actual sleep audits accompany run.
fixture: 64KiB generated synthetic random-base64 plaintext with fresh AES-GCM per scalar/custom JSON row, EXTERNAL storage

resourceSampler.definition: sum resident RSS of benchmark Node process and all native descendants, excluding PostgreSQL server daemon; sampled with ps

envelope.clockPolicy: Full verifier duration, including header/fence/chunk checks and owned cleanup; no source-clock subtraction
envelope.warmupMethod: Complete read-only native pg_dump --data-only to /dev/null immediately before measurement

hostSleepAudit.source: Actual timestamped pmset -g log events normalized to UTC; independent of ordinary-idle lease

samplingDisclosure: External ps sampler uses a requested100ms delay plus Docker/ps overhead; complete captured process lifetime and actual sample count are reported. Internal RSS sampling uses25ms.
benchmarkScope: Standalone coordinator and scoped metadata fixture using production backup/rotation/verifier helpers; actual CLI functional integration is separate and does not establish full application bootstrap RSS.
baselineTimingScope: baselineMs is the source iterator lifetime; all preparation/control/flush costs remain in totalMs and overheadMs.
actualConcurrentWork: Unrelated next-build/Node/turbo/esbuild workload saturated host. One-second aggregate idle0–6% through much ofrun; cumulative process CPU and full raw aggregates retained. Correlation does not establish sole timing cause; no normalization.
remainingGate: Isolated final-source all-pass warm/cold1GiB,warm/cold20GiB and near-limit-row acceptance matrix, concluding review/report.
disposition: Explicit NONACCEPTANCE correctness/resource/fixture diagnostic; unchanged overhead and throughput gates failed under sustained shared-host work. Never release acceptance.

pageSizingEvidence.qualification: Maintenance4 is derived from exact bounded projected size and production8MiB/(projected*2) budget; reader2 is also observed directly in backup output. No row cap/heap/protocol/source changes.

logicalSizeDisclosure: Generic benchmark reports base1GiB; exact stress-adjusted logical bytes and649900byte delta are separate largeRowFixture fields. Both plaintext and ciphertext bytes are actual measured bytes.
